text_block_list.text:
After outing――
Sakura Bakushin O once
again down in dumps.

Feeling down because about
to say goodbye to freckled
classmate.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
…Know that at Tracen Academy,
students often leave.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Believed…! Would stay with entire
class whole time, growing together,
working hard together, graduating
together!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Even so, day to say goodbye
comes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As class president, want do something
for her in remaining time, but――
choice_data_list: Why don't you give her a present?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh!
Superb idea!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If gift parting one, want make
something stay in heart forever!
Hmhmhm, what to pick…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Run, you say?

Time spent training for last
race invaluable to her.

Why not one last, fun run
together? Suggestion made――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hoho, as expected of Trainer!
Magnificent idea!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Training memorable time not
only for her, but for me too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: So――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
Invite her tomorrow ASAP!

Next day, saw Sakura Bakushin O and
freckled classmate on field.
choice_data_list: Good to see the sun is shining!
Good to see the sun is shining!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Beautiful blue sky without
single cloud――ideal conditions for
Bakushin-ing!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Feels nostalgic～.
Feels long ago training
together!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fu-fu, feel same.
Without further ado, let's start!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No need go easy!
Clash without holding anything
back!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Won't lose, Baku-chan!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yes! Bakushiiiiiiiii―n!

With smiles bright as
sun, started to run.

Kept running as much as
time and energy allowed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah… 
That was fine bakushin running!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
You too, Baku-chan. 
That was really fun run together!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
…Really grateful 
to Baku-chan and Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to both of you, 
feel totally refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Where did this come from? 
Told you before, no?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As class president, merely did 
my duty!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… Just that?

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Thought we were becoming 
good friends, Baku-chan…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
N-no! Of course, 
because you are dear friend too!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks.♪ 
Stay friends with me from now on too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! 
Even far apart, still friends!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ――Forever and always!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Song, you say?!

Tracen Academy Umamusume 
convey feelings through 
races and live performances.

Suggested Sakura Bakushin O 
sing song about her feelings 
and hold live performance――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I will do it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am Tracen student! 
And class president, role model 
for all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let us make best song with 
whole class, give unforgettable 
live show!

Next day. 
Gym rented out for concert.
choice_data_list: Here, the lead singer goes in the middle.

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
R-really okay? 
Entire live show just for me―

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Totally okay! 
We all worked super hard to prepare!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks to everyone, 
made spectacular song! 
Will deliver best cheer song ever witnessed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come, come! Whole class 
about to start Bakushin Live!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"――Dash straight ahead～♪ 
Even if parted now～♪"

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah!

Sakura Bakushin O's earnest song 
and cheerful chorus echoed. 
But at end――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …Even if… we are apart…

Sakura Bakushin O choked up 
and looked down.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Forgive me, I――

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text:
"――Heart runs straight line～♪ 
Connected under blue sky～♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: E-everyone…?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
(…Indeed. What am I doing? 
Overcome by emotions, 
ruining live performance――)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
(As class president, as Sakura Bakushin O, 
must deliver this song…!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Farewell? No no, wrong♪ 
Marching to future, moving forward…～♪"

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: "Bakushin! Bakushin!"

Sakura Bakushin O recovered, 
and concert finished smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, apologies for pathetic display 
earlier.

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Nothing to apologize for! 
Thank you for wonderful show!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: …Will keep running after leaving academy.

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Because goodbye is "bakushin 
straight into future", right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
…Precisely! 
Let us run together again someday!

Thus, through parting, Sakura 
Bakushin O grew little more mature.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Cheer, you say?!

She feels just as sad about moving 
as Sakura Bakushin O does about parting.

Leaving like this makes sad memory. 
Suggested sending off with big cheer――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I… see! 
…Quite right, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All right! Will give cheer 
with absolute full power!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Make sure memories of Tracen 
always bring smile to her face…!
Then, day of farewell――

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for seeing me off, everyone! 
Baku-chan's Trainer too!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I will! 
Take care too, Trainer, Baku-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
…Truth is, wanted same class forever, 
graduating together… Urk, uuuuugh!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Baku-chan…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, mind made up! 
As class president, send off 
with huge smile!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Everyone――here goes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hurray! Hurray! Fight on!
Full Speed Ahead・Great Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text:
Hurray! Hurray! Fight on!
Full Speed Ahead・Great Bakushin!

Sakura Bakushin O and classmates 
sent loud, heartfelt cheer to departing friend.

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Sad to leave, 
but will do best out there!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Got to go now. 
Stay well, everyone…!

As girl ran toward gate, 
watched by all until out of sight, 
Sakura Bakushin O dashed after.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
――P-please wait! 
One last thing…!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Even far away, still your class 
president! 
That will never change…!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: …Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Glad were in same class― 
glad Baku-chan is our class president!

Figure fully gone now, 
Sakura Bakushin O looked down quietly.

Next moment, 
she looked up and turned around.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let us go, everyone! For her sake too, 
make names known across nation!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now, toward future, Bakushin-bakushin!

Resounding cheerful voice 
warmed hearts of everyone around.
